fig2_caption: Faithfulness gap (insertion AUC minus deletion AUC, minus the same for random orders) of Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients and occlusion (a perturbation-matched reference) beside the model-independent edge-map control, blurred fill, Kermany attribution list (820 images in 680 patient/duplicate groups). (a) Per model; (b) per class, pooled over the six models; the method means are pre-specified outputs, the per-class edge-map values are post hoc (D10); NORMAL is descriptive. Points are means; bars are pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples of the groups.
table1_note: Pre-specified contrasts (analysis plan committed before data access). Estimate with pointwise 95% cluster-bootstrap interval; p from a studentised bootstrap test, Holm-adjusted within each family of nine; <0.001 means the smallest attainable value with 10,000 resamples. Seed robust (H1 only): yes if the absolute contrast exceeds the largest seed SD of the models involved.
table2_note: POST HOC (D10): edge-adjusted gap = method gap minus edge-map gap on the same image, model, seed and fill, averaged over seeds; mean with pointwise 95% cluster-bootstrap interval, no tests. Test balanced accuracy: mean over three seeds on the full Kermany test partition (22,537 images; CNV, DME, DRUSEN, NORMAL).
